lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Seven distinct high-contrast vertical lines visible on the primary subject. Spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso with slight compression toward the posterior region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the third vertical line from the shoulder, splitting near the dorsal ridge.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and sixth vertical lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the ventral margin of the torso.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lateral posterior haunch, positioned vertically relative to each other.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns exhibit a spiral lyrate trajectory, curving outward and backward from the base before angling inward and upward toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the horn tips is approximately 1.5 times the width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: The ivory-colored terminal tips represent approximately 10% of the total vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright orange 'sock' pigmentation on all four lower limbs; white chevron between eyes; white fringe along the dorsal ridge and ventral neck.
